Programs of Study
Explore a diverse range of programs and degrees designed to prepare students for success in the life and physical sciences. Whether your interests lie in biology, chemistry, mathematics, or related disciplines, the College of Life and Physical Sciences offers rigorous academic pathways that foster discovery, critical thinking, and hands-on learning. Students are equipped with the knowledge and skills needed for graduate study, professional programs, and rewarding careers in science, education, research, and industry.

Biological Sciences
The Department of Biological Sciences was established in 1927; at the time there were five faculty members. At its inception courses were offered in various disciplines, such as zoology and botany. The focus of the Department gradually changed from preparing students for careers in secondary education to preparing them for entry into professional and graduate schools.
Chemistry
Our mission is to provide rigorous education to students, whose career path requires a thorough understanding of the fundamental principles of chemistry through designing and continuously improving curricula. We aim to prepare students for entry into graduate or professional schools, and to provide solutions to problems related to the human health, economic development, environment and other local or global issues.
Mathematical Sciences
The mission of the Department of Mathematical Sciences is to prepare our majors to pursue careers or advanced degrees in the mathematical sciences or related fields by providing excellent undergraduate instruction that promotes life-long learning and an appreciation for mathematics and its applications. Additionally, the department is committed to delivering quality mathematics education to all students at the University. This mission aligns with the institutional mission of preparing students for professional success and personal achievement.
MARC (Minority Access to Research Careers)
Tennessee State University is designated by the Carnegie Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as a R2: Doctoral Institution – High Research Activity. The university engages in cutting-edge research to address critical challenges in our society. Our research arm supports faculty and students by taking their ideas from conception to fruition in critical areas such as agricultural sciences, engineering, biotechnology, nanomaterials, health sciences, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, astrophysics, business and the social sciences.
